RUNTIME CORROBORATION: war3map.j:51694 Trig_berserker_2_Actions restores SetUnitVertexColorBJ(udg_BerserkerUnit,30,30,30,0) and war3map.j:52027 Trig_Gigantomakhia_2_Actions does the same - the map's rest state is 30% grey, NOT white. U00L.name: 北斗之鼠
U00L.evidence: TASK #263. war3map.w3u custom entry U00L (model HeroPikachu.mdl) sets NO uclr/uclg/uclb of its own; its base is the ORIGINAL-table entry Umal, which sets uclr=uclg=uclb=200 -> 0.7843 each. #49 resolved only 'entry has its own mod' and 'entry -> stock UnitUI.slk' and had no w3u->w3u step, so this one champion was dropped. It is the 變身 alternate form of 拳四郎 (TRANSFORM_FORMS pair 25, counterpart godie-umal which DOES carry 0.7843), so the miss was visible in play: transforming washed the grey off. Re-derived by tools/w3x-import/resolve_unit_tints.py; see out/GoDieEX22s-src/UNIT_TINTS.json entry U00L (channelSource = w3u:Umal(original) x3, baseChain = [U00L, Umal]).

restore after the A0AZ branch (100,100,100,0 = opaque white).
same state on the A072 branch of Trig_XFight.

同上 — the A0W5 caster may also be the upgraded 外掛開很大的死神 (H01O).

同上 for the O02L duplicate.

ORIGINAL-MAP BUG: restores to WHITE and erases 美白大法師's static [0.1961,0.1961,0.1961] for the rest of the match. Port must restore to champion.tint.

狂戰士之怒 expiry — restores to 30% grey, NOT white. This is the map itself confirming that Berserker's rest state is the 黑 (champion.tint 0.3137, w3u 80/255).
